messages:
Marco (Procurement): FYI — NexaSupply just pushed an ETA update for H100 batch 4: lead time slipped from ~18d to ~34d. They proposed a hybrid air+sea consolidation to cover priority orders. We need to decide on a holdback policy and RMA flow for partial DOA cases.

NexaSupply (vendor): Sorry about the slip — sea leg congestion at EC port. We can offer N+1 air topups for priority SKUs but it adds ~$1.8k/unit. We're willing to absorb 50% of expedite cost if Redwood accepts a consolidated RMA AWB handling (one AWB per consolidated pallet).

Ashley (Fleet Ops): If we accept air topups we MUST have a holdback pool for immediate swap of DOA units. Otherwise on-call and cluster fill will spike. 5–10% holdback per region seems sensible.

Luis (Eng Infra): Agree on the holdback. Also, we need serial manifests as early as possible — autoscaler and inventory reconciliation require serial+sku. SFTP or S3 drop will work.

NexaSupply (vendor): We can drop a daily manifest CSV to s3://redwood-uploads/procurement/h100-batch4/ by 09:00 UTC each day. AWB list + proforma invoice included in the manifest package. For returns handling we prefer one consolidated RMA AWB per outbound shipment to simplify customs.

Emma (Logistics): Consolidated AWB okay, but customs teams will need per-unit HS codes and warranty docs. Can you add an HS code column in the manifest and include a warranty statement PDF? Also confirm broker contact and incoterms (DAP vs DDP) for EU.

VendorBot: PO#78921 status -> partial-shipped :truck:

Ashley (Fleet Ops): Proposed policy: holdback_pool = min(ceil(0.08 * allocation), 2) per region (so small allocations still keep a buffer). Air topups limited to priority customers; vendor covers expedite cost beyond 2% of each region's allocation. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Marco (Procurement): Sounds reasonable. NexaSupply — can you commit to an 8% holdback reserve for NA and EU and to the daily manifest timeline? Also confirm your credit note process for expedite refunds.

NexaSupply (vendor): We can commit to 8% holdback for EU and NA for this batch. Daily manifest by 09:00 UTC. For expedite refunds: 30-day claim window, credit note applied to the next invoice; we'll send a short SLA amendment for signatures.

Luis (Eng Infra): One more ops constraint: if customs holds >4% of a region's shipment we need an automatic cascade to re-route freed capacity from the DE region pool to avoid cluster starvation. Can Ops/SRE add an alert on net incoming-serial rate?

Ashley (Fleet Ops): I'll add the cascade to the Ops runbook and set an alert threshold. SRE, can you add a synthetic that fails if serial-ingest rate < expected by 12h?

Emma (Logistics): I'll share the EU broker contact and incoterm preference (we should aim DAP with customs broker on file). NexaSupply, I'll cc procurement on the broker email.

Marco (Procurement): Action items: 1) NexaSupply add HS codes + AWB column + s3 manifest by 09:00 UTC (NexaSupply). 2) Legal to sign 8% holdback SLA amendment (Marco/Legal). 3) Fleet Ops update runbook and alerts (Ashley). 4) Eng Infra add serial-ingest alert & cascade (Luis). 5) Logistics share broker contact (Emma). I'll follow up in 24h.

Ashley (Fleet Ops): Quick CSV header sample for manifest, please match this format if possible:

```
serial,sku,hs_code,awb,shipment_date,condition
ABC123,H100-80GB,847330,WB123456789,2026-03-24,NEW
```

NexaSupply (vendor): Will do — we'll mirror that header and attach warranty_statement.pdf and a consolidated AWB manifest. Draft SLA patch coming in the next email.

Marco (Procurement): Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. If we get the manifest and broker details today we can lock the holdback and proceed with partial air topups for top-tier customers. :thumbsup:
